summary: 周六 EIPs 仓库集中合并：EIP-8261 gas limit 排期、EIP-8266 frame 交易的过期 nonce、EIP-8268 区块访问列表中的存储根，以及把每个执行层区块的存款请求上限设为 8192 的新 EIP。ethresear.ch 提出 AetherWeave，用质押绑定网络身份来抵御日蚀和 Sybil 攻击。

items.title: 新 EIP：限制每区块存款请求数
items.note: （barnabasbusa）合并，上限 `MAX_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK = 8192`，与共识层 SSZ 上限一致，第 8193 个请求会让共识层解码失败，实测约在 1.93 亿 gas 时触发。
items.title_en: New EIP: Cap Deposit Requests Per Block
items.note_en: (barnabasbusa), merged, with `MAX_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK = 8192` matching the consensus layer SSZ bound; an 8193rd request breaks CL decoding, observed empirically at about 193M gas.

items.title: ethresear.ch：AetherWeave，以太坊的质押支持节点发现
items.note: 01:12（Kaya Alpturer、Constantine Doumanidis、Aviv Zohar）：共识层让身份昂贵，节点发现层却仍视网络身份为廉价，节点在共识开始前就暴露于日蚀和 Sybil 攻击。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: AetherWeave, stake-backed peer discovery for Ethereum
items.note_en: 01:12 (Kaya Alpturer, Constantine Doumanidis, Aviv Zohar): the consensus layer makes identities expensive, but peer discovery still treats network identities as cheap, leaving nodes exposed to eclipse and Sybil attacks before consensus even begins.

summary_en: A Saturday of merges in the EIPs repo: EIP-8261 gas limit schedule, EIP-8266 expiring nonces for frame transactions, EIP-8268 storage roots in block access lists, and a new EIP capping deposit requests per execution layer block at 8192. ethresear.ch proposed AetherWeave, which ties network identity to stake to resist eclipse and Sybil attacks.
